notes.title: Achievement Hotfix
notes.content:
Modifications to the achievements have been made.
 - A previously unobtainable achievement has been made obtainable.

notes.title: Update Notes for October 3rd
notes.content:
A difficultly adjuster has been added!
 - This can be accessed via the Options menu at the start screen
 - The difficulty can also be changed in game by pressing the bracket keys " [ " or " ] "

Music options have been added!
 - Music can be stopped by pressing the minus key " - "
 - Music can be changed by pressing 1-9. Each number holds two songs to choose from.
